title: Efficient homogeneous electrochemical water oxidation catalysed by macrocyclic nickel complexes with redox non-innocent pyridine coordination structures
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2014-2021
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01776E, Paper
Junqi Lin, Jinlin Hu, Zhichao Qi, Lianghui Zhang, Zezhen Wang, Xiangming Liang, Zhijun Ruan
Two Ni complexes are used as water oxidation catalyst. Complex 1 with pyridine-amine ligand is found to be a molecular catalyst, while complex 2 with amine ligand is a pre-catalyst, revealing that the pyridine ring benefits their stability.
